items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I remember in 1940 going fishing with Lionel and Irving Goodman and Lionel's wife, my wife and Charlie.

ctx.x: You could never be certain where you caught it, but I suspect so, because he was pretty sick when he came with the band.

I remember in 1940 going fishing with Lionel and Irving Goodman and Lionel's wife, my wife and Charlie. I don't fish but I went along, it was fun to ride around the island on a boat, and he was pretty sick then. That was the first time I knew that he had
been. I know later on, that following winter, he had a hemorrhage on a plane.
